review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-04 delegated author, .NET 10.0.14 repair); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-04 repair after GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9 (.NET Brotli Decoder out-of-bounds write, patched in .NET 10.0.14), which made the locked Docker restore fail with NU1903 on Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler 10.0.12 and so blocked every Cloud image build. The successor of the admission at cloud-release-r84. The toolchain moves from SDK 10.0.401 / runtime 10.0.12 to SDK 10.0.403 / runtime 10.0.14: global.json, the Dockerfile image pins (sdk:10.0.403-noble-aot and runtime-deps:10.0.14-noble-chiseled, both by multi-arch index digest) and the regenerated NuGet locks (Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler and its runtime packs, Microsoft.NET.ILLink.Tasks). No source, Go, Worker or product change; the vulnerability audit is unchanged. The .NET licence texts (LICENSE.TXT, the runtime and ASP.NET Core THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES) hash the same at the 10.0.14 source commit 0427b9abbead3fa64c6655eb4290c537397131fa as at the 10.0.12 commit, and the six Ubuntu base copyright files of the new runtime-deps image hash the same as the profile recorded, so no legal record changes. The release profile cloud-release-r85 with its successor records center-runtime-r31 and center-worker-r31 binds the build inputs as they are at this change.
